name: KATALIS demo symbol — LIFE.JK, the suspended thin-float mover
status: EXECUTED 2026-09-11 — 7 calls, 7 credits, all 200. Findings: research/plan/demo-symbol-LIFE.md
notes: Why LIFE.JK and not another symbol. Chosen for zero credits by crossing two payloads already on disk: recorded/v2_free-float.json (961 rows, LIFE free_float 0.075 — the thinnest float among all top-changes gainers) against recorded/v2_companies_top-changes.json (LIFE +50.59% 7d, +124.23% 14d, +118.45% 30d, as of 2026-09-04).

The reason it beats every other candidate: recorded/v2_suspensions.json already carries TWO LIFE.JK suspensions, 2026-09-02 and 2026-09-04, both reason 'peningkatan harga kumulatif yang signifikan ... cooling down'. That makes this a LABELED event, not just a mover. A card generated as-of 2026-09-01 either raised a pillar before the first suspension or it did not, and a judge can check which from the repo.
Every call below is one KATALIS reads in pillars.bag_from(). Nothing here is exploratory.
Not bought, because already on disk and symbol-independent: /v2/brokers/ (registry, 88 codes), /v2/free-float/ (961 rows including LIFE), /v2/suspensions/ (20 rows including both LIFE events).
Not bought, because KATALIS does not read it: /v2/foreign-flow/ — the foreign split is derived by joining the broker registry's is_foreign against broker-summary, at zero extra credit.

The company report is requested with sections=financials, one section, one credit. Without the sections parameter it bills 8. Only outstanding_shares is needed, and it lives at financials.historical_financials[].outstanding_shares.

The daily and index-daily windows deliberately request 2026-05-01..2026-09-10, wider than 90 days. The PRP claims /v2/daily/ silently truncates to the last 90 days rather than erroring. Same credit either way, so this call also settles that claim.
The broker-summary window is 14 calendar days, the client-side guard the PRP sets while the real limit is undocumented. 2026-08-22..2026-09-04 covers the run-up and both suspension dates.

EXECUTED 2026-09-11. All seven returned 200. Outcome: /v2/daily/ truncates to 90 CALENDAR days (62 trading rows), not 90 trading days; sections=financials billed 1 and narrowed the payload to three keys; the LIFE tape carries 32 broker codes and all 32 map to the registry; /v2/filings/ returned total_count 0; the API sent no cost headers on any call.

calls.note: baseline_days=45 + event_window=3 + scan. Also tests the 90-day truncation claim.
momentum needs IHSG over the same baseline; the recorded ihsg payload is only 20 rows, 2026-08-06..2026-09-04.
Pilar 1. 14-day guard. Joins locally against the cached /v2/brokers/ registry for origin and cohort at zero extra credit.
outstanding_shares, the denominator of float terserap. One section = one credit.
Pilar 4 preceding/following split. news_lookback_days=7, so 2026-08-01 is generous.
